tasks.label: Redshot: build, instalar en /Applications y relanzar
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && { [ -f Package.swift ] || cd Redshot; } && bash Scripts/build_app.sh && pkill -x Redshot; sleep 1; rm -rf /Applications/Redshot.app && cp -R build/Redshot.app /Applications/ && LOG="$(dirname "$PWD")/redshot.log"; : > "$LOG"; (nohup /Applications/Redshot.app/Contents/MacOS/Redshot >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; echo '--- pgrep ---'; pgrep -fl Redshot; echo '--- log ---'; cat "$LOG"; echo '>>> Redshot relanzado desde /Applications. Log en' "$LOG"

tasks.label: Redshot: ver log
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && { [ -f Package.swift ] || cd Redshot; } && echo '--- pgrep ---'; pgrep -fl Redshot; echo '--- log ---'; cat "$(dirname "$PWD")/redshot.log"
